target: CS Navigator Labs 0.20.0-beta.3 skill exposure in ChatGPT

observed_user_producing_session.source: User-pasted audit from a separate ChatGPT conversation
observed_user_producing_session.limitation: No independent producing-session trace or plugin selection/install UI screenshot supplied

persisted_plugin_source.source: Plugin Creator account release, not a host install/activation record

candidates: Plugin release stored but not actually installed/selected in the chat
Cached/stale host plugin registration or new release not refreshed
Host compatibility or ingestion issue for combined skills+registered app

checks: Open ChatGPT Plugins > Personal and locate CS Navigator Labs separately from CS Navigator Registry app
Confirm the Labs plugin is installed/enabled, shows six included skills if the surface exposes them, and the displayed version is 0.20.0-beta.3 if version visibility is offered
If Install plugin is shown, install and authorize its registered Registry app if requested
Refresh ChatGPT, create a new chat explicitly selecting CS Navigator Labs via composer/@, verify its skill appears and its file is actually read
If Skills tab/feature unavailable due to plan/workspace limitations, report platform gate and do not claim workaround
remediation_gate.test_prompt: Com CS Navigator Labs selecionado, liste as skills disponíveis nesta conversa, leia a skill cs-navigator-labs e diga a versão encontrada no arquivo. Execute registry_status separadamente. Não invente qualquer leitura.
remediation_gate.acceptance: Actual skill read trace + MCP call trace in same conversation; source-only read-back is insufficient

next_step: Verify plugin installation/selection, platform access and skill reader exposure in ChatGPT host before changing package or publicizing beta.
